messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

constexpr int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
vector<vector<lld>> M;

struct MAT{
  vector<vector<int>> m;
  MAT operator * (const MAT &ot)const{
    MAT ret;
    for (int i = 0; i<=K; i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j<=K; j++) {
        ret.m[i].resize(K);
        for (int k = 0; k<=K; k++)
          ret.m[i][j] = (ret.m[i][j] + (lld)m[i][k] * ot.m[k][j]) % MOD;
      }
      ret.m[i].shrink_to_fit();
    }
    return ret;
  }
  friend istream& operator >> (istream& in, MAT &ot);
  friend ostream& operator << (ostream& out, const MAT &ot);
};

istream& operator >> (istream& in, MAT &ot) {
  for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j<= K; j++) {
      in >> ot.m[i][j];
    }
  }
  return in;
}

ostream& operator << (ostream& out, const MAT &ot) {
  for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
      out << ot.m[i][j] << " ";
    } out << "\n";
  }
  return out;
}

int main() {
  int N, K;
  cin >> N >> K;
  vector<int>base_k;
  vector<MAT> A(K, vector<MAT>(K));
  for (;N;N/=K) base_k.push_back(N%K);
  for (int i = 0; i < K; i++){
    for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) A[i][i].m[j].resize(K);
    A[i][i].m[i][i] = 1;
    A[i][i].m[i].shrink_to_fit();
    for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) A[i][0].m[j].resize(K);
    A[i][0].m[i].resize(K);
    A[i][0].m[i][j] = 1;
  }
  for (int i = 1; i < sz(base_k); i++){
    for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
      A[i-1][j] = A[i-1][j];
      if (j > 0) A[i-1][j].m.resize(K);
      A[i-1][j].m[j - 1].resize(K);
    }
    MAT tmp = A[i-1][0];
    for (int j = 1; j < K; j++)
      A[i-1][j] = A[i-1][j-1] * tmp;
    for (int j = K - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      A[i][K-1-j].m.resize(K);
      A[i][K-1-j] = A[i-1][K-1-j];
      if (j != K - 1) A[i][K-1-j] = A[i-1][K-1-j] * A[i][K];
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < K; j++)
      A[i][j] = A[i-1][j];
      if (j > 0) A[i][j].m.resize(K);
      A[i][j] = A[i][j] * A[i-1][j];
  }
  MAT res(K, vector<int>(K, 0));
  for (int i = 0; i<=K; i++) res.m[i][i] = 1;
  for (int i = sz(base_k); i--;){
    res = res * A[i][x];
    x = (x+1)%K;
  }
  int ans = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) ans = (ans + res.m[i][K]) % MOD;
  cout << ans << endl;
}
